content:
hana: following the outage post-migration, proposing a proactive probing layer: lightweight canary probes from edge proxies to candidate regions before switching traffic. goal: avoid blind swaps when path/peering transiently degrades.

ravi: love it. probes need to mimic real-workload (kv lookups + small generation) not just ICMP. also must respect tenant residency: probes must never move PII across borders.

mel: operational constraints: probes add traffic. suggest adaptive sampling: higher sampling during higher variance windows, otherwise 1 probe/min per tenant group.

hana: sketch of flow:
```
- proxy detects p95 rise -> schedule N probes to remote region
- probe returns latency+error+model-warm metric
- control-plane aggregates over window W and recomputes regional score
- only swap if probe-backed score margin and residency rules allow
```

infra-bot: scheduled test: canary-probes v0.2 -> staging 2025-08-03T04:00Z.

ravi: also propose a lightweight predictive model that flags likely sustained degradations based on short-term slope features; model voting combined with probes can reduce false positives. simple logistic regressor first.

mel: must add safety: quick-override on dataplane error spike, and operator knob to disable probes for privacy-sensitive tenants. add audit events: probe_id, probe_result, decision_rationale.

sec: security note: probes touching model state must obey residency. mark probe payloads as non-PII; encrypt probe headers; log minimally. will review.

hana: next steps: I'll open RFC with probe API, sampling config, and ML-vote interface. Ravi/Mel please add canary tests: probe cost budget and privacy gating.
